classes.label: Detection Event

classes.label: Digital System Entity

classes.label: Enduring Entity
classes.comment: A thing that persists through time while potentially changing state. This is the CAC-facing root for all object-like entities including people, organizations, devices, artifacts, places, and assessment results.

classes.label: Entity

classes.label: Event

classes.label: Exploitation Event

classes.label: Legal Event

classes.label: Occurrent

classes.label: Organization-Like Entity

classes.label: Person-Like Entity

classes.label: Phase

classes.label: Place-Like Entity
